meta.title: PokerStudio Replayer — replay your hands and study better
meta.description: Replay your cash and tournament hands in the browser, rate every decision, write comments per street and share the session with your coach. Free for a limited time.

cta.free: Free for a limited time. Take advantage now!
cta.opensReplayer: Opens the PokerStudio Replayer in a new tab

hero.headline: Review every decision and turn your hands into real study.
hero.sub: PokerStudio Replayer replays your cash and tournament hand histories in the browser — hand by hand, street by street — so you can rate your decisions, write notes and share the session with your coach.
hero.audience: For players who study on their own, players who work with a coach, and coaches and poker teams.

features.title: What the Replayer does
features.lead: Eight things you can do with a session that has already been imported.

replay.title: Replay your cash and tournament hands
replay.text: Import the hand history and watch every hand play out: seats, positions, stacks in chips or big blinds, board and pot, in 3D or 2D.

feedback.title: Feedback per hand and comments per street
feedback.text: Each hand takes a score, leak tags and a written comment, plus separate notes for preflop, flop, turn and river.

resume.title: Pick your review up where you left off
resume.text: The session remembers the hand and the frame each assessor stopped on, so a long review can be done in several sittings.

save.title: Save and organise reviews in the database
save.text: Reviews live in your account, not in one browser: your sessions, notes and assessments follow you across devices.

share.title: Share a session with your coach
share.text: Generate a link with a password and an expiry date. Your coach reviews it asynchronously, with no account and no e-mail exchange.

reports.title: Read reports and find your main leaks
reports.text: A report brings together scores, the share of hands reviewed and the leak tags that came up most often, ready to export.

evolution.title: Follow how your assessments evolve
evolution.text: Your self-assessment series and the coaches' average, over a date range, with a trend line.

skins.title: Customise table, cards and looks
skins.text: The skin editor changes deck style and colours, card backs, table, zoom and spacing. Save, duplicate, export and import your skins.

how.title: How it works
how.lead: From the file your poker room exports to a review you can act on.

import.title: Import your hand history
import.text: Load the .txt files your poker room exports. Everything is read in the browser.

review.title: Review the session in the Replayer
review.text: Go through the hands, use the filters and stop wherever a decision deserves a second look.

assess.title: Rate it yourself, or share it with a coach
assess.text: Write your own assessment, or send a link with a password so a coach can do it.

read.title: Read the feedback and the reports
read.text: Scores, leak tags and comments per hand and per street, gathered in one report.

follow.title: Follow your evolution
follow.text: Compare sessions over time and see whether the same leaks keep coming back.

coach.title: Review with a coach
coach.lead: The player keeps control of the session; the coach only needs the link and the password.

link.title: A link and a password
link.text: The password never travels in the URL and is never stored in the clear.

expiry.title: Temporary access, with an expiry date
expiry.text: You choose how long the link lasts when you create it, within the range the administration allows.

async.title: Asynchronous assessment
async.text: The coach works whenever it suits them; nobody has to be online at the same time.

scores.title: Scores from 0 to 100, tags and comments
scores.text: Each hand takes a score, the leak tags that apply and a written comment.

partial.title: Partial feedback as it arrives
partial.text: The player follows what has already been written while the coach is still working.

several.title: Several coaches, separate assessments
several.text: Each invitation produces its own reading, and one coach never sees another's.

compare.title: Compared with your own assessment
compare.text: Your reading and the coach's sit side by side, hand by hand.

pdf.title: Individual and comparative reports
pdf.text: Export to PDF, on your own or with every assessment of the session together.

reports.title: Reports and evolution
reports.lead: What the numbers say — and what they do not.
reports.disclaimer: These are assessments of decisions, written by you or by your coach. The Replayer does not promise profit and does not analyse hands with AI.

score.title: Scores from 0 to 100
score.text: One score per hand, and the session's average.

coverage.title: Share of hands reviewed
coverage.text: How much of the session has actually been assessed.

leaks.title: Main leaks
leaks.text: Ranked from the tags recorded on the hands.

self.title: Self-assessment series
self.text: Your own scores, session after session.

coaches.title: Coaches' average
coaches.text: A second series with the average of the assessments you received.

filter.title: Date filter and trend line
filter.text: Narrow the window and see which way the series is going.

chart.caption: Illustration of the evolution chart — not a capture of the product.
chart.alt: Illustrative chart with two series of scores from 0 to 100 over time: self-assessment and the coaches' average, with a trend line.

rooms.title: Poker rooms
rooms.lead: The importer reads .txt hand histories from PokerStars and the Chico network. The other rooms are on the way.
rooms.note: Importing uses .txt files. The rooms marked "coming soon" are already recognised by the importer but not yet replayed: we would rather say so than hand you a hand put back together wrongly. PokerStudio has no commercial relationship with these rooms; the names appear only to show which formats are read.

roadmap.title: Coming soon
roadmap.lead: Planned, not available yet. No release dates are announced.

shared.title: Review shared with a coach or a friend
shared.text: A link and a password for whoever you ask to read your hands, with a deadline and a way to revoke it, keeping your own assessment and each coach’s apart.

audio.title: Coach feedback by audio
audio.text: Recorded comments attached to the hand.

video.title: Coach feedback by video
video.text: A recorded walkthrough of the hand, alongside the written notes.

profile.title: Coach profile
profile.text: Sign-up by e-mail and an area to follow students.

dashboard.title: Dashboard and analytics
dashboard.text: An overview of your sessions and assessments in one place.

ai.title: Real-time AI analysis
ai.text: Based on Nash and GTO, and on importing your own strategy.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Short answers about what the Replayer does today.

free.a: Yes — free for a limited time. Creating an account is free too, and an account is what you need to save your reviews.

files.a: The .txt hand history files your poker room exports. No other format is supported.

formats.a: Both. The Replayer reads cash tables and tournaments, including levels, antes and bounties.

rooms.a: The rooms listed in the poker rooms section above, always from their .txt export.

skins.q: Can I change how the table looks?
skins.a: Yes. The skin editor changes deck style and colours, card backs, table, zoom and spacing, and your skins can be exported and imported.

coach.q: How does a review with a coach work?
coach.a: You generate a link with a password and an expiry date. Your coach opens it, goes through the hands and leaves scores from 0 to 100, leak tags and comments — asynchronously, with no account.

reports.q: Do I get partial and final reports?
reports.a: You follow the feedback as it is written, and once an assessment is completed it is closed and can be exported to PDF, on its own or compared with the others.

expiry.q: How long does a shared link last?
expiry.a: You choose the expiry when you create it. The allowed range is set by the administration and can change, so it is not fixed here.

final.title: Bring your next session and review it properly.
final.sub: Import a .txt file, go through the hands and see where the decisions cost you.
